URL uses subdomain trick to impersonate legitimate payroll domain

Multiple failed MFA attempts on HR system from external IP
example.detection_method: Deploy email gateway filters to detect domains using subdomain tricks and new registrations; monitor outbound HTTP POST requests from HR desktop IPs to suspicious external servers; alert on failed MFA attempts from unfamiliar IPs; implement URL rewriting and scanning to identify obfuscated phishing links; network IDS signatures for suspicious HTTP POST payloads containing JSON employee data.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

validation.comments: The sample aligns well with the stated problem of spear phishing targeting HR personnel to steal employee PII. The scenario describes a convincing phishing email impersonating payroll updates, which is a realistic and common lure for HR staff. The technical data is comprehensive and includes detailed email headers, suspicious URL analysis showing subdomain impersonation, domain registration info indicating recent creation and privacy protection, DNS records, SMTP logs, webserver access logs, network captures, payload obfuscation details, and post-exploitation artifacts such as data exfiltration and login attempts. The indicators clearly explain why this is a spear phishing attack targeting HR, highlighting domain tricks, email authentication results, suspicious URL, access logs, exfiltration, and MFA bypass attempts. The detection methods and relevant MITRE techniques are appropriate and cover email filtering, network monitoring, authentication alerts, and phishing link detection. All required fields are present and accurately populated, making this a complete, realistic, and correct representation of the problem.
